name: HPMC Pre-Filled Syringes 2ml / 3ml
short_description: Sterile 2% w/v Hydroxypropyl Methylcellulose (HPMC) ophthalmic viscosurgical device (OVD) for anterior segment surgical chamber maintenance.
long_description:
2% w/v Hydroxypropyl Methylcellulose (HPMC)

The ophthalmic viscosurgical device (OVD) is a sterile, isotonic, apyrogenic viscoelastic solution of highly purified, non inflammatory hydroxy propyl methyl cellulose (HPMC) solution with a high molecular weight greater than 80,000 Daltons for intraocular use during the surgery of the anterior segment of the eye.
For a 2% w/v HPMC solution each ml of solution provides 20mg of HPMC dissolved in balanced salt solution.
The viscosity of this solution is 4000 to 5500 cps.

Indications:
The OVD is indicated for use as an ophthalmic surgical aid in anterior segment surgical procedures, such as cataract extraction and intraocular lens implantation. The OVD maintains a deep chamber during anterior segment surgery and thereby allowing for more efficient manipulation with significantly less trauma to the corneal endothelium and other ocular tissues.

Contraindications:
At present, there are no known contraindications, when used by a trained ophthalmic surgeon, as indicated.

Warnings:
• Do not use the package if the integrity of the sterile package is compromised
• The OVD is for intraocular use only
• The OVD is for single use only
• The device is not to be placed in the direct sunlight or temperature exceeding 40°C
• Do not resterilize the device

Storage:
Store at a temperature between 15°C and 35°C and a relative humidity less than 65%. Protect from freezing. Do not expose containers to direct sunlight.

Supply:
Sterile solution of 2% w/v hydroxypropyl methylcellulose is available in 2 ml, 3 ml PFS in pouch pack. 5 ml vial with pouch in pack of ten.

short_description: Sterile Schirmer tear test diagnostic paper strips with printed 0–35 mm graduation scale for quantitative assessment of lacrimal tear secretion.

name: Capsular Tension Rings (CTR) (Model PR 1109 / PR 1210)
short_description: High-precision ophthalmic capsular tension rings (ctr) (model pr 1109 / pr 1210) featuring micro-engineered atraumatic profile, designed for micro-surgical ophthalmic procedures with superior tactile response.
long_description:
The Capsular Tension Rings (CTR) (Model PR 1109 / PR 1210) is an indispensable microsurgical instrument manufactured from high-purity medical-grade titanium or stainless steel for ophthalmic surgical procedures.

Specifically engineered for micro-surgical ophthalmic procedures, it incorporates a micro-engineered atraumatic profile that provides surgeons with exceptional tactile feedback, minimal tissue trauma, and precise manual control under operative microscopes.

Its ergonomic handling and high optical precision prevents hand fatigue during extended procedures while resisting corrosive fluids and repeated autoclaving cycles. Manufactured in compliance with international ISO 13485 surgical device standards.

Reduced risk of capsular fibrosis and shrinking.
Safe IOL centration in eye with zonular dehiscence.
